claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented the feature for frai-gate. Here's a summary of what was added:

## Changes Made

### 1. **Added `renderSummary()` function** (`src/gate/report.ts`)
   - Returns a one-line summary in the format: `<VERDICT> <answered>/<total>`
   - `total` is always 7 (the number of GATE_CHECKS)
   - `answered` counts checks without block-severity findings
   - Appends blocked check IDs (comma-space separated, in GATE_CHECKS order) when verdict is BLOCK
   - Special case: Returns `BLOCK 0/7: structure` when the gate section is missing

### 2. **Added `--summary` flag to CLI** (`src/cli.ts`)
   - New flag `--summary` prints only the summary line instead of the full report
   - `--json` takes priority if both `--json` and `--summary` are provided
   - Exit codes remain the same (1 on BLOCK, 0 otherwise)
   - Updated HELP text to document the new flag
   - Updated error message to include the new flag

### 3. **Exported `renderSummary`** (`src/index.ts`)
   - Added to public API exports

### 4. **Comprehensive Test Suite** (`src/gate/report.test.ts`)
   - 8 test cases covering:
     - PASS with all checks answered
     - WARN with answered checks  
     - BLOCK with blocked checks listed in order
     - Special case for missing gate section
     - Proper handling of mixed block and warning findings
     - Deduplication of check IDs from multiple findings

## Test Results
✅ All 19 tests passing (2 test files)
✅ Build succeeds with no errors
✅ `pnpm --filter frai-gate build` completes successfully
✅ `pnpm --filter frai-gate test` all green

The feature is ready to use. For example:
- `frai-gate check FRAI-SPEC.md --summary` outputs `PASS 7/7` or `BLOCK 5/7: evaluation, transparency`
